description: UI recipe for exporting BRG1X / BRG1Y / Kph CSVs from ADRE Sxp. Copy to adre_export_recipe.json and replace every placeholder after running tools/adre_ui_map.py on the EC2 box with ADRE open.

steps.note: Let ADRE finish starting / show the main window

steps.message: Map File → Open (or equivalent) in ADRE, then put the real menu_click / open_file_dialog steps here. Path placeholder: {database}
Map the Export Channel / Save As CSV action for BRG1X into {inbox}
Map the export for BRG1Y into {inbox}
Map the export for the keyphasor into {inbox}

steps.note: Succeed once three CSVs land in the inbox
